title: KnownEnvironmentsUpdatedPayload

name.description: An environment's name as the client has it: 1 to 200 characters once trimmed, counted as code points, no control or format (zero-width) characters other than white space; kept trimmed with white space collapsed.

address.description: The address the client uses for the environment, as its connection keeps it: an http or https origin, http://host:port.

items.description: An environment of the union: its name and the address a client uses for it.

environments.description: The union of what the live client sessions report, this environment left out, each name and address once, sorted by name, then address: what the orientation block's other environments section lists.

description: The known environments' union changed: the union as it now is.
